main_text.p: אכר ܐܟܪ Syr. Vipera. Græc. est, ἔχιδνα. Plur. ܐܟܪܝܢ, Viperæ.
אכח Syr. Unà, simul, pariter. Videtur deductum ex Hebraeo יחד vel יחדו.

אכל Ch. ܐܟܠ Syr. Edit, comedit, absumpsit, devoravit: Item Vociferare, clamare, proclamare, promulgare, divulgare: Item Rugire, tonare, personare, & sic sæpe in fine assumit ܐܟܠܝ, ac si esset Aphel ex Verbis Quiescentibus tertiâ radicali. Adjunctū sibi etiam habet sæpissimè Nomen קרצא, & tum significat, Divulgare criminationem, accusare, deferre, obtrectare, calumniari. Ithpeh. Chald.
אתאכל, Syré, ܐܬܐܟܠ Edit, Comedit, activè: & passivè, Edi, comedi, absumi, consumi. Aphel Ch. אוכל, Syr. ܐܐܟܠ Comedere fecit, Comedendum dedit, cibavit, pavit, depavit.
אוכלא Ch. Idem. Item, Fimus, stercus, excrementum.
מכלתא, מיכלא, מיכל Ch. ܡܟܠܬܐ Syr. Idem. Plur. ܡܟܠܐ A' cibis, 1.ad Tim.4.3. ad Hebr.13.9.
ܐܟܠܢ Syr. Ærugo, quasi Adesio vel Erofio dicta, ut Græc. βρῶσις, Matt.6.19.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are transcribed as best as legible; vocalisation marks and some Syriac points are uncertain and may be imperfect. The Greek ἔχιδνα and βρῶσις are approximate.
